objective: Forward out-of-sample paper trading validation of LightGBM swing predictions with breakout confirmation and ATR risk control

target_definition.description: Predict whether next trading day High reaches at least +2% from today Close

entry_trigger.description: Enter only when price crosses +0.25% above today's close (confirms momentum, rejects opening gap-downs)
entry_trigger.order_type: Buy Stop-Limit / Buy Stop at breakout trigger

profit_target.description: Fixed +2.00% target above executed entry price

stop_loss.description: Dynamic volatility stop loss set 1.2x ATR below executed entry price

execution_parameters.maximum_holding_period: 1 trading session (Exit at market close 3:25 PM IST if neither target nor stop reached)

handling_rules.not_triggered: If session High < breakout trigger, order is cancelled with zero PnL (Status: NOT_TRIGGERED)
handling_rules.gap_up_above_trigger: If session Open > trigger, Entry = session Open (accounts for gap premium)
handling_rules.ambiguous_both_hit: If both target and stop are inside the daily High-Low candle, stop-loss is conservatively assumed hit first (Status: AMBIGUOUS / STOP_HIT)
handling_rules.time_exit: If neither target nor stop is hit, position closes at session Close (Status: TIME_EXIT)
